newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London quiet ahead of holiday.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London quiet ahead of holiday.

text.p: Japanese stocks traded in London were passing an extremely quiet session on Monday ahead of a holiday in Tokyo, dealers said.
"With the holiday in Tokyo tomorrow (Tuesday) all we're seeing is tidying up (of positions) in small sizes," a trader at a Japanese bank said.
At 1400 GMT the Nikkei 50, at 1512.88, was 2.82 points (0.19 percent) up from its opening level.

Mitsubishi Chemical Corp was marked up 27 yen (6.6 percent) to 432.5 yen in London when it announced after the Tokyo close it will buy back 40 billion yen of its own stock or up to 100 million shares, after gaining shareholder approval at a meeting on June 27.
Mitsubishi Chemical also said after Tokyo hours its parent current forecast for 1996/97 was revised to 13.5 billion yen from 3.0 billion yen.
In light Tokyo trading, the benchmark Nikkei 225 index closed 57.51 points, or 0.31 percent, higher at 18,670.37 on volume of just 257 million shares.
Tokyo markets will be closed Tuesday for Green Day.
